name: Impeccable
tagline: Design vocabulary and anti-slop detector for AI coding agents
description: Impeccable is a free, open-source design skill by Paul Bakaus that gives AI coding harnesses a shared vocabulary for UI craft: 23 slash commands (/shape, /typeset, /layout, /polish, /distill, /harden, /audit, /critique, /live ...) plus a deterministic detector of 64 rules that catches the visual tells of AI-generated design before they ship. It installs into Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build and a dozen other harnesses with one npx command, and writes its state to two portable files, PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md (Google Stitch format). It also ships a Chrome extension for the detector overlay and a CLI you can run in CI. Aimed at anyone whose agent keeps producing purple-cyan gradient hero sections with an eyebrow pill and a glassmorphic card.
agent_guidance: Install this before you write UI, not after: run `npx impeccable install`, then `/impeccable init` to produce PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md so every later command edits against a declared system instead of inventing one. Reach for named commands over vague prompts — /typeset, /layout and /distill fix specific failure classes, and /audit plus `npx impeccable detect` give you a deterministic pass/fail you can gate a PR on. It complements rather than replaces a component library: pair it with shadcn/ui or your own tokens, and expect it to argue with a design system you never wrote down, so write DESIGN.md first if the project already has a brand. Note the plugin marketplace route (`/plugin marketplace add pbakaus/impeccable`) if npx install is blocked in the sandbox.
why_it_matters: The first widely adopted attempt to make 'AI design slop' a checkable, rule-based defect class rather than a vibe, and its DESIGN.md/PRODUCT.md pair is becoming a de-facto interchange format between agents.
notable_for: Live Mode: pick an element, get three variants
evidence: https://impeccable.style, https://impeccable.style/docs/, https://impeccable.style/slop/, https://impeccable.style/designing/, https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable, https://registry.npmjs.org/impeccable (latest 3.6.0 published 2026-08-14).
